# Normalization test fixtures

These DOCX/PPTX files were generated by the Studydy B2-P prototype from original synthetic text.
No private teaching material, credentials, learner data or model-generated content is included.
DOCX: Chinese, code, duplicate paragraphs, a 65-row table and explicit page break.
PPTX: three slides; slide 2 hidden; each source slide has a synthetic speaker-notes marker.
Generator: `prototypes/document_normalization/probe.py` (`docx_fixture`, `fodp_fixture`, isolated Impress export).

`sample.doc` and `sample.ppt` were exported from these same synthetic DOCX/PPTX
files using isolated LibreOffice 26.2.5.2 (`MS Word 97` / `MS PowerPoint 97`).
They contain no real teaching material. They exercise legacy binary input and
normalized-page fallback without inventing original paragraph/slide locators.
